# Patched `ant-plus`

This version of `ant-plus` has been custom-patched to fix several stability issues regarding USB connections and channel leaks.

## Applied Fixes:
1. **SYNC missing crash fix**: Modified `src/ant.ts` and `build/ant.js` (`USBDriver.prototype.open`) to scan for the `0xA4` sync byte and ignore parsing errors instead of throwing `SYNC missing`. This prevents the `node-usb` polling loop from dying permanently on bad data.
2. **Auto-resume on error**: Modified `src/ant.ts` and `build/ant.js` (`inEp.on('error')`) to call `startPoll()` on error. This prevents transient USB errors from permanently halting data reception.
3. **Channel slot leak fix**: Modified `src/ant.ts` and `build/ant.js` (`BaseSensor.prototype.scan` and `attach`) to properly call `this.stick.detach(this)` upon receiving `MESSAGE_CHANNEL_UNASSIGN`. This prevents the dongle from running out of available channels (maxChannels) when connections are repeatedly lost and re-established.

## Maintenance Note
If you ever update this package via `npm install`, you **MUST** re-apply these patches, or use a tool like `patch-package` to manage them automatically. Since this project distributes `package_node_modules` directly for users who cannot run `npm`, these patches are directly committed to the repository.
